equations.source: P_fuel=P_generator_electric/eta_gen; m_diesel_gen=P_fuel*dt/43e6; H_waste=P_fuel−P_generator_electric; H_gen_host=.55*H_waste; P_gen_export=.45*H_waste; selected useful-path loss=.1*P_generator_electric enters host
equations.accumulator: Track one common Q_acc stored J. Discharge useful contribution=eta_discharge*(−dQ/dt); do not apply usable_fraction twice. Charge/discharge/path losses enter host. Local caps only if fitted.
equations.propulsion: m_diesel_prop=alpha*abs(F_actual)*dt; P_fuel=m_dot*43e6; selected useful=.32P_fuel; selected host=.05*(P_fuel−P_useful); outward exhaust=(1−.05)*(P_fuel−P_useful); chemical propulsion has zero fake electrical draw
equations.laser: P_beam=eta_laser*P_bus_actual; H_laser=(1−eta_laser)*P_bus_actual; no second old f_emit multiplier
equations.h2: m_H2=(Q_host+H_aux)*dt/q; bound host request/cap/shared remaining physical mass; never count same cryotank twice
equations.background: Allocate after Active/local-cap recovery and battery recovery. Never make background consume common Q_acc; within-step actual source/fuel/thermal/SoC headroom must hold. below80% zero; between80–100 use explicitly experimental linear headroom share.
equations.thermal_protection: Per module compare one T_ship against low/high limits; shut down at <=crit_low or >=crit_high; restart only inside hysteresis band; ordinary Civilian has no thermal override
